authority.eligibleVoterSet: Every identity with a valid Newbie, Verified, or Human proof at the canonical ValidationFinished checkpoint
authority.identityCountPurpose: Admission plus participation and deliberation floors; no numerical-majority gate, standalone one-person-one-vote term, or direct candidate-ranking weight
authority.identityVotingPower: Each eligible identity supplies at most one distinct-voter slot and, when approving, one approval slot; decision power otherwise comes from the sum of per-identity sublinear stake weights
authority.stakeVotingPowerShape: monotone nondecreasing and sublinear after deterministic integer flooring
authority.fixedTotalStakePartitionEffect: For total stake S split evenly across n valid identities, summed weight is approximately n^0.1 * S^0.9 before integer flooring; this is a positive but sublinear identity-count effect
authority.sybilBoundary: Valid identities cannot create weight without checkpoint stake or replace the combined raw-stake threshold, but stake splitting across valid identities gives a limited sublinear weight advantage
authority.voteBinding: One exact Radicle revision; changing the revision requires new ballots

decisionExamples.result: approve if all non-ballot gates pass
